## Review state

- [ ] This PR is a draft while work or evidence remains
- [ ] Canonical inputs and generated outputs are in the same commit
- [ ] No raw archive files, credentials, or unnecessary personal data are committed
- [ ] The author has not approved their own work
- [ ] Historical review requested when claims, identities, relationships, captions, or rights changed
- [ ] Implementation review requested when code, navigation, schema, or generated data changed
